scope: Selected numeric matrix values and derived, de-identified shape-task sufficient statistics. Quadrilateral vectors use the 55 unordered off-diagonal pairs; memory uses all 8500 matched trials and five distractors per trial; cross-format matrices retain 72 images and exclude words. Independent arithmetic from deposited outputs, without neural-network inference, training, minimum-program search, cohort reconciliation or biological validation. Input hashes identify upstream extraction inputs; the offline verifier does not download or authenticate them.
